errors.text_span: und den USA mit etwa 15 Prozent
errors.evidence: The bar for the USA is visibly above the 15% line, at approximately 15.5-16%, almost the same height as the bar for Sweden (Schweden). The stated value of 15% is an underestimation.

errors.text_span: Deutschland, Dänemark und die EU27 weisen jeweils etwa 7 Prozent auf
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While Germany (Deutschland) is at approximately 7%, the EU27 bar is much lower, at about 4.5%. Stating it is 7% is a significant error.

errors.text_span: während Frankreich, Italien und Spanien jeweils etwa 3 Prozent erreichen
errors.evidence: The description generalizes that these three countries are all at 3%. However, the bar for France (Frankreich) is visibly higher than the bars for Italy (Italien) and Spain (Spanien), reaching approximately 3.5% or 4%.

errors.text_span: wobei keine zusätzliche Sortierung oder visuelle Hervorhebung außer der Farbgebung für OECD und EU27 erfolgt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims there is 'keine zusätzliche Sortierung' (no additional sorting). The bars and their corresponding categories on the x-axis are clearly sorted in descending order of value, which is a key structural feature of the chart.
